provenance.method: Derived statistics from decoding the locally installed Serum 2 library (.SerumPreset/.SerumFX/.SerumFXRack) and this project's FL-saved processor states with fruitylink_serum.xfer; no preset payloads are stored.
provenance.engine_reference: Serum 2 (productVersion up to 2.1.4), FL Studio 26.1.3 wrapper displays

scale_vocabulary.linear_gain: 0..1 amplitude; FL % = sqrt(value)*100; dB = 20*log10(value) (+3 dB for Main Vol)
scale_vocabulary.lfo_rate: Hz in free mode; division index when synced

sections.Oscillator0: Oscillator A (wavetable by default; WTOsc0 sub-section holds the table path and position)
sections.Oscillator3: Noise oscillator (SampleOsc3 for the noise sample)
sections.ModSlot0..63: Mod matrix rows: source [id, sub], destModuleTypeString/destModuleID/destModuleParamName, plainParams.kParamAmount
sections.Global0: Global/voice settings (master volume, mono/legato/portamento, bends, bus levels, oversampling)
sections.FXRack0..2: FX racks: 0 = main insert chain, 1..2 = FX buses (see fx-schema.json)
sections.component / product / productVersion / v: processor identity fields required by the VST3 state (see loading.normalize_processor_state)

fl_anchors.fl_normalized_to_state: 1/3 -> -1 oct read back; consistent with -4..4 over 0..1 only if the range is -3..3: unresolved
0.0 kSine(default,absent) / 0.4 kTriangle / 0.6 kSaw / 0.8 kSquare / 1.0 kPulse; kRoundRect ~0.2
seconds (FL display ms); fl->seconds curve unknown

parameters.fl_parameter_note: Env 1 Attack (0.015 read back as 15 ms)
Env 1 Decay (2.46 read back as 2.46 s)
Main Vol; FL % = sqrt(value)*100, FL dB = 20*log10(value) + 3 (0.3025 -> 55% [-7.4 dB])
LFO n Rate; Hz when Free and BeatSync=0, otherwise a division index
Sub Shape; FL normalized 0.0 Sine, 0.4 Triangle, 0.6 Saw, 0.8 Square, 1.0 Pulse (kRoundRect is the rounded-square entry)
A WT Pos; 0..256 spans the whole table: frame ~= value/256*numFrames (88.29 on a 166-frame table displayed as frame 57)
A Uni Detune; FL display = value^2 (0.316 -> 0.10)
A Uni Blend (81.99 read back as 82)
A/B/C/Sub Octave (-4..4); Sub -1 read back as '-1 oct'
A/B/C Level, Noise Level, Sub Level: FL % = sqrt(value)*100; 0.7586 read back as 87% [-2.4 dB]

confidence_vocabulary.verified: a live FL readback matched the rule (tools/harvest_live.py stamps this)
confidence_vocabulary.inferred: unit reasoned from the key name, observed range or FL display name
